verdict.rationale: Drata documents the building blocks of a compliance program inside the product: controls with requirement mappings, a Policy Center with policy versions, an Evidence Library, frameworks and audits. A community thread also ties Drata to obtaining a 'SOC 2 Audited' certificate. However, nothing in the pack names SOC 2, Type I versus Type II, the Trust Services Criteria, prebuilt SOC 2 policy templates, or auditor evidence requests. missing for 10: explicit SOC 2 framework documentation, Type I and Type II audit workflow, built-in Trust Services control set, required SOC 2 policy templates, auditor evidence-request handling, hands-on corroboration of an end-to-end SOC 2 run.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run a SOC 2 program end to end — Type I and Type II — with the Trust Services controls, required policies, and evidence requests built into the platform

citations.quote: Create Control ... Modify Control ... List Requirements for Control ... Reset Control Requirement Mappings ... Compare Control Requirements
Create Evidence Library Item ... Update Evidence Library Item ... Get Evidence Library Version
List Frameworks ... Create Custom Framework ... List Framework Requirements ... Create Framework Requirements
the Drata requirement came from sales wanting to show prospects a 'SOC 2 Audited' certificate
